headline: Current portals, reader updates and usable developer resources

items.evidence: Real subsequent feed updates appear after an earlier acknowledgement; same update stays acknowledged; unavailable/empty feed never fabricates progress. Actual modal and return panel work at desktop/mobile in all themes.

items.title: A decision-ready private studio briefing

items.title: Make the existing feeds and integrations usable
items.insight: Verified source gap: scripts/build-api-index.mjs contains ['/feed.xml', 'RSS feed', 'Site updates as an RSS. Founder explicitly expanded the active goal to this outcome.
items.evidence: Every existing catalog entry remains reachable. Current feed URLs and sample GET contracts verified; POST samples never executed. Generator checks and focused behavior tests pass. All-theme desktop/mobile captures reviewed; no unobserved growth uplift claimed.

items.title: Updates that tell readers what changed
items.insight: Verified source gap: data/consumer-changelog.json contains "updated": "2026-09-17". Founder explicitly expanded the active goal to this outcome.
